title: Add active refinements info for the menu, hierarchicalMenu and the refinementList widgets
body:
Would be great to add more info in the markup about the active. That would help to build UI/UX where the list of those possible filter items are hidden. We could for instance imagine to have: * add a class at the top level that there is 1 or more items selected * add a count value in the `ais-menu--header` to indicate how many items have been selected (+ extra attribute, to get that value easily accessible programmatically) ![pasted image at 2016\_05\_05 23\_26](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1101220/15152209/af404e30-16d4-11e6-9265-88bf6dae3a4a.png) ```html
